teaser: The reader's vault runs on newsroom.sgit.ai: a passkey opens three real vaults, each device writes one file, and the architecture is drawn as it stands.
core_idea: Between the morning of 11 October and 02:22 UTC on 12 October the reader's vault went from a design to a running feature on newsroom.sgit.ai: a Vault pane on every page enables the account with a passkey, creates a door at its derived address, a master and a reader vault as real sgit vaults through the vendored vault library, writes each device's raw records as one file in one commit, and brings other devices' activity into the browser so the meter shows one balance; local storage stays primary, the vault holds records never totals, one file per device means no conflict by construction, eight test files run in CI against a mock of the vault server plus a CLI round trip, and a live check on an iPad confirmed it; the properties of what runs are the constraints the next brief is thought with.

nodes.label: The vault pane, running
nodes.summary: A Vault button beside the balance on every newsroom page: enable, create once, update, see every device, bring their activity here.

nodes.label: Door, master, reader vault
nodes.summary: Three real vaults: the door at its derived address holds the master's key and its record; the master holds the reader's key, the access key and the doors; the reader vault holds the activity files.

nodes.label: One code base, vendored
nodes.summary: The vault UI library v0.2.3 that runs dev.vault.sgraph.ai, twelve files unedited with every SHA-256 checked at build, and one local patch pending upstream.

nodes.label: Local storage stays primary
nodes.summary: The meter is unchanged; the vault is a copy the reader keeps current by pressing a button, so the number of commits is the number of presses.

nodes.label: Records, never totals
nodes.summary: Reads, top-ups and personas go in raw; reads, spend, declined, credit and balance are recomputed from the records with one starting credit.

nodes.label: One file per device
nodes.summary: Each device writes what it originated to its own file, whole; two devices never write the same file; brought-in records keep their author.

nodes.label: Eight test files, then an iPad
nodes.summary: The account, the sync logic, two devices in Chromium with a virtual authenticator, a CLI round trip in CI; then three vaults made from an iCloud Keychain passkey on a real device.

nodes.label: From design to pane in a night
nodes.summary: 22:56 the lab, 00:15 the finding, 01:33 real vaults, 01:57 the live check, 02:22 the pane; none of the steps skipped.

nodes.label: The properties are the constraints I think with
nodes.summary: The next brief could not be written until this ran, because what works and what does not is what limits the scope enough to think.

nodes.label: Not built
nodes.summary: Pruning local storage, retiring a device, rotating the master, automatic sync, the key pairs, the persona vault, the notes lane; each designed, with experiments listed first.

quotes.text: Two devices never write the same file, so there is nothing to merge and no conflict by construction.
The constraints limit the scope of what I write, and that is what lets me write it.
quotes.why: Why shipping comes before the next brief.

quotes.text: The design went to the lab, the lab corrected the design, the corrected design was built, and the build was checked on a real device before the pane that readers see was written over it.
quotes.why: The sequence, and why the speed is not recklessness.
